text:
taylor: Quick help — demo with NovaBank in 30m. They keep hitting 403 on our /v1/generate endpoint. Error says: {\"error\":{\"message\":\"permission denied: org mismatch\",\"code\":403}}. They swear they copied key from UI. :sweat_smile:

jamal: that string is classic org-binding. Ask for the header dump (sanitized). Also get key id + account id.

taylor: here's what they pasted (sanitized):
`Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_novabank`
`Redwood-Org: novabank-production`
No X-Project. Dashboard shows key bound to `novabank-poc` org.

presales-bot: Note: test keys created via the sales console are sometimes bound to a staging org by default. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/auth#bindings :information_source:

anya: simplest: tell them to set `Redwood-Org: novabank-poc` in header for the demo. If security won't let them change client config we can create a short-lived override mapping server-side.

jamal: can you get account id and key id? Also did they try SDK vs raw curl? SDKs sometimes cache org in config.

taylor: account `acct_55821`, key id `key_nb_demo`. They use an internal SDK wrapper so they might be pulling org from env var.

anya: env var mismatch is common. Ask them to run `env | grep -i redwood` or show their SDK config. Meanwhile I'll open a ticket to add mapping for acct_55821 -> map requests with `Redwood-Org: novabank-production` to `novabank-poc` for 1 hour. @ops can you approve temporary mapping and RPS bump to 25 for demo?

ops: approve 60-min mapping and RPS bump to 25. Add audit entry: "Sales demo temporary mapping for acct_55821; approver ops; expire in 60m." Security notified.

jamal: also mention 429 seen earlier? They reported intermittent 429s during stress test. If so we should bump rate limit during window.

taylor: they saw a few 429s earlier. Please bump. Also I'll send them test curl to try after header change: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_novabank" 
 -H "Redwood-Org: novabank-poc" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"status"}'
```
If returns 200 they are unblocked.

presales-bot: Debug tips: [x] verify key id, [x] verify account id, [x] check SDK env var for org, [x] try explicit `Redwood-Org` header, [x] request server-side mapping if customer cannot change config. Collect `x-rw-request-id` header if still failing.

taylor: thanks all — pinging customer now. Will report back after they test. :thumbsup:
